_comment: FPVLink system configuration — edit this file and restart the service to apply changes.

device._comment: Human-readable device identity. Version follows semver.
device.name: FPVLink

capture._comment: USB capture layer configuration for DJI FPV goggles.
capture._goggles_model_comment: Which goggles variant to expect on USB. Options: 'v1v2' (DJI FPV Goggles V1/V2), 'goggles2' (DJI Goggles 2 / Goggles Integra), 'auto' (try both, slower init).
capture._interface_comment: USB interface number that carries the video bulk endpoints.
capture._ep_out_comment: USB bulk-OUT endpoint number (host → device, for control commands).
capture._ep_in_comment: USB bulk-IN endpoint number (device → host, receives raw H.265 stream).
capture._usb_vid_comment: USB Vendor ID for DJI devices (0x2CA3). Do not change unless using a different brand.
capture._usb_pid_comment: USB Product ID. 'auto' probes for known DJI PIDs (0x001F for V1/V2, 0x0046 for Goggles 2). Set explicitly to lock to one model.
capture._read_timeout_ms_comment: Milliseconds to wait for a USB bulk read before timing out and retrying.
capture._max_packet_size_comment: Maximum USB transfer size in bytes per read call. Larger = fewer syscalls. Must be a multiple of the USB wMaxPacketSize (usually 512 or 1024).

pipeline._bitrate_kbps_comment: Target encode bitrate in kilobits per second for streaming outputs (SRT/RTMP).
pipeline._codec_comment: Output codec for streaming branches. Only 'h264' is currently supported. 'h265' output is planned for a future release.
pipeline._use_hardware_comment: If true, use Rockchip MPP (mppvideodec / mppvideoenc) for decode+encode. If false, or if rkmpp plugin is unavailable, falls back to avdec_h265 + x264enc (software — high CPU, higher latency).
pipeline._latency_mode_comment: Preset that tunes internal queue depths and encoder settings. Options: 'low' (2-buffer queues, zero-latency encoder tune — ideal for FPV), 'balanced' (4-buffer queues, moderate quality), 'quality' (8-buffer queues, higher quality encoder settings — not recommended for real-time).
pipeline._keyframe_interval_comment: Encoder keyframe interval in frames. At 30fps, 60 = 2-second GOP. Shorter GOPs improve seek latency but increase bitrate.
pipeline._decode_disable_error_comment: Pass disable-error=true to mppvideodec so non-fatal decoding errors (e.g. partial NAL units) don't abort the pipeline.

outputs._comment: Output destinations. Each can be independently enabled or disabled.

srt._comment: SRT (Secure Reliable Transport) streaming. Low-latency, UDP-based, tolerates packet loss. Ideal for local network or point-to-point IP links.
srt._url_comment: Full SRT URI, e.g. 'srt://192.168.1.50:9000' for caller mode or 'srt://:9000' for listener mode.
srt._latency_ms_comment: SRT end-to-end latency in milliseconds. Lower = less delay, higher = more resilient to packet loss. 100ms is a good balance for local WiFi.
srt._wait_for_connection_comment: If false, srtsink won't block the pipeline when no receiver is connected. Set true if you want pipeline start to wait for a viewer.

rtmp._comment: RTMP streaming for platforms like YouTube Live, Twitch, or a local NGINX-RTMP server.
rtmp._url_comment: RTMP base URL, e.g. 'rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2'. The stream key from stream_key or from STREAM_KEY_YOUTUBE env var is appended automatically.
rtmp._stream_key_comment: RTMP stream key. Leave blank to read from STREAM_KEY_YOUTUBE / STREAM_KEY_TWITCH environment variables (more secure — keys not stored in this file).
rtmp._buffer_ms_comment: Internal RTMP output buffer in milliseconds. Increase if you see 'rtmpsink: buffer underflow' warnings.

rtsp._comment: RTSP server (future feature — not yet implemented in v0.1.0).
rtsp._port_comment: RTSP server port. Standard RTSP port is 554 but that requires root; 8554 works as a non-root user.
rtsp._path_comment: RTSP mount path. Full URL will be rtsp://device-ip:8554/live.

hdmi._comment: Direct HDMI output via KMS/DRM. Zero-copy hardware decoded feed.
hdmi._connector_id_comment: HDMI connector ID. 217 targets the dedicated HDMI0 out. Set explicitly to target specific HDMI port.
hdmi._plane_id_comment: DRM plane on connector 217's CRTC (89). 194 is a native-NV12 video overlay, so the decoder's NV12 reaches the panel with no software videoconvert. Auto-select picks RGB-only plane 178, which forces a CPU-heavy convert. Currently hardcoded in capture/pipeline.py (KMS_PLANE_ID); this field documents it.

ndi._comment: NDI (Network Device Interface) output. Broadcasts a low-latency NDI source on the LAN, auto-discovered by OBS, vMix, and NDI Studio Monitor. Taps the decoded NV12 feed directly (no color convert). Toggling this restarts the pipeline to apply (~3s standby blip).
ndi.name: FPVLink
ndi._name_comment: NDI source name shown to receivers on the network.

web._comment: Embedded web UI / control API server (Node.js Express).
web._port_comment: TCP port for the web server. Can be overridden with FPVLINK_PORT env var.
web._allow_remote_comment: If false, the web server binds to 127.0.0.1 only (localhost-only access). Set true to bind to 0.0.0.0 and allow access from other devices on the network. WARNING: there is no authentication yet; only enable this on a trusted network.
web._session_secret_comment: Secret for signing session cookies. Leave empty to auto-generate on startup (sessions won't survive restarts). Set a fixed value for persistent sessions.

network._prefer_ethernet_comment: If true, SRT and RTMP traffic is routed via the Ethernet interface when available, preferring it over WiFi for stability.
network._srt_port_comment: Local UDP port for the SRT listener (when this device acts as the SRT server). Opened in the firewall by the setup script.
network._srt_interface_comment: Bind SRT listener to a specific interface (e.g. 'eth0'). Leave blank to bind to all interfaces.

logging._level_comment: Log verbosity. Options: 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug'. Can be overridden with LOG_LEVEL env var. Use 'debug' to see full GStreamer pipeline strings.
logging._gst_debug_comment: GStreamer debug level (GST_DEBUG). 0=none, 1=error, 2=warn, 3=fixme, 4=info, 5=debug. Passed as environment variable to the Python process.
logging._file_comment: Optional path to write logs to a file in addition to systemd journal. Leave empty to log to journal only.
